ideas.text: An AI that intercepts @channel messages and asks the sender to justify themselves to a panel.
A bot that detects when you're typing an angry Slack message and holds it for 4 minutes.
An app that marks you as Away the moment your heart rate drops below 'presentable.'
A tool that converts an 8-message stream of consciousness into a single coherent paragraph before sending.
An AI that detects when your 'thumbs up' emoji response is passive-aggressive and suggests a warmer alternative.
A bot that archives channels that haven't had a real message in 30 days and sends a eulogy.
An app that auto-replies to 'quick question?' with 'it never is, but go ahead.'
A tool that detects when someone is using Slack as email and attaches a 5-paragraph essay in a single message.
An AI that reads the vibe of a message thread and warns you if replying will make things worse.
A bot that calculates the combined cost of everyone who was pinged by an @here that affected 200 people.
An app that turns 'per my last message' into a formal incident report.
A tool that detects when the typing indicator appears and then disappears 4 times and sends you a wellness check.
An AI that identifies which Slack channels exist only to make one person feel important.
A bot that translates emoji-only responses into actual words so you know what people meant.
An app that detects when your status has said 'in a meeting' for 6 consecutive hours and raises a flag.
A tool that identifies the person who always replies with 'noted' and tracks whether they ever acted on anything.
An AI that detects when a thread has gone 40 replies deep and summons a decision-maker to end it.
A bot that tells you which Slack messages you've been marked as 'seen' on and ignored for over 48 hours.
An app that flags when a colleague has sent you a message at 11pm and scheduled it to look like 9am.
A tool that detects when you've been added to 3 new channels this week and asks if anyone checked with you first.
An AI that transcribes a 3-hour Slack debate and reveals that both sides agreed from the start.
A bot that auto-generates a Slack channel for every meeting that ends without a decision.
An app that detects when someone posts a 9-paragraph message in a chat tool and emails it to them as a lesson.
A tool that tracks who has responded to your message and who has clearly read it and chosen violence.
An AI that identifies the one person who DMs you every time instead of using the team channel, always about the same thing.
A bot that detects when you've been added to a channel called '#urgent' and it was created 6 months ago.
An app that counts how many messages you send per day and compares it to how much work you shipped.
A tool that detects 'I think we're aligned' in a thread and counts the number of misaligned replies that follow.
An AI that auto-translates corporate Slack messages into what the sender actually wanted to say.
A bot that removes you from channels where you've never spoken and adds you back if anyone notices.
An app that rates the passive-aggression level of your Slack message before you send it, on a scale of 1 to lawsuit.
A tool that detects when a Slack thread has evolved into a full project and suggests getting a Jira ticket.
An AI that counts how many channels you're in versus how many you've ever posted in and generates a shame report.
A bot that sends 'you okay?' to anyone who reacted with 🙂 to a difficult message.
An app that detects when 'sounds good!' means 'I haven't read this' and follows up with a comprehension check.
A tool that identifies the colleague who always starts a new thread instead of replying to the existing one.
An AI that converts your 11pm Slack send into a scheduled 9am message and adds 'slept on it' to the opening.
A bot that detects when a message was sent to the wrong channel and immediately offers witness protection.
An app that counts how many people are currently marked 'away' despite appearing to be in your meeting.
A tool that detects when Slackbot has been programmed to respond to normal words and removes it before it learns more.
An AI that intercepts 'can we hop on a quick call?' and converts it to a 3-bullet async message instead.
A bot that detects when your workspace has more channels than employees and declares a state of emergency.
An app that reads all unread Slack messages from your vacation and summarizes them as 'nothing that needed you.'
A tool that detects when you've been removed from a channel without explanation and sends a diplomatic inquiry.
An AI that identifies which of your Slack messages were read by your manager within 30 seconds of being sent.
A bot that archives the #random channel every January 1st and recreates it because people get upset.
An app that detects the phrase 'circle back on this' and sends a recurring reminder until something actually happens.
A tool that identifies when a Slack conversation has become a policy debate and escalates it to someone who can actually decide.
An AI that detects 'lmk if you have bandwidth' and converts it to 'I need this by Thursday, can you help?'
A bot that detects when you're using Slack to avoid doing the thing the Slack message is about.
An app that counts how many reaction emojis your posts get versus your manager's posts and graphs the power gap.
A tool that detects when 'this is not urgent' is in the same message as three exclamation points.
An AI that estimates how many of your sent messages have never been read and assigns them a read probability score.
A bot that detects when you've sent a DM and the other person joined a public channel 2 minutes later, ignoring you.
An app that intercepts messages with 'just checking in' and asks you to try again with what you actually want.
